evidence: Modifies src/kernel/ and the C API (src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp) to decouple error notifications from translation machinery.
rationale: Replaces string-based error notifications across the kernel boundary with typed data structures to eliminate node translation dependencies. As noted in the description, this directly advances tracking issue #27587 by removing `translation.h` usage from libbitcoinkernel, which represents core boundary decoupling work for the project.
